title: 1Q84
author: Haruki Murakami
summary: In Tokyo in 1984, a fitness instructor with a secret life and a maths teacher who moonlights as a ghostwriter each slip into a world that is subtly different from the one they knew. Their paths, tied by a childhood bond, start to converge.
readIf: you want a huge, hypnotic novel that blends romance, a cult thriller and the supernatural.
skipIf: you want a brisk read or are uneasy with graphic sexual violence and abuse of girls.

pairings.reason: A shorter Murakami novel with a similar eerie atmosphere and parallel storylines that eventually meet.
Equally sprawling and surreal, with a more bewildered, everyman hero.
The title is a nod to Orwell's novel, and both stories involve a powerful hidden force reshaping reality.
